# SujithSoft

> SujithSoft is the software studio of Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake, making fast, private desktop apps for Windows. Home: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/

## S Converter

> S Converter is a free, offline, all-in-one file converter for Windows 10 and 11, made by Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake. It converts images, video, audio, documents, PDFs and archives in batches on the user's own PC. Files are never uploaded, and it needs no account.

- Website: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NKD1BD2RM1X (installs without a SmartScreen warning; updated by the Store)
- Download (latest installer): https://github.com/SujithShalitha/s-converter-releases/releases/latest
- Price: free, no ads, no watermark on output files
- Platform: Windows 10 (1803 or newer) and Windows 11, 64-bit. Not available for macOS, Linux, Android or iOS.

### What it does

- Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, BMP, SVG, HEIC/HEIF (iPhone) and camera RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF, ORF, RW2) to JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF or PDF. Resize, compress, presets (Email, Instagram, Web, Thumbnail).
- Video: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV, WebM, MPEG, M4V, 3GP, TS, VOB, MTS/M2TS, OGV to MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM, GIF, WMV, FLV, MPEG, 3GP, TS. GPU encoding on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD. Trim, resize, make GIFs, extract audio.
- Audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA, M4A, AIFF, Opus, AMR, AC3 (and audio from any video) to MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, Opus, AIFF, WMA, AC3, AMR.
- Documents, without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice: DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, PPTX, PPT, ODP, XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV to PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF, HTML, TXT, Markdown, XLSX.
- PDF tools: images to PDF, PDF to images, merge, split, compress, rotate, add page numbers, extract pages.
- Watermarks: text or logo on photos and videos, with a live preview.
- Archives: create ZIP, 7Z, RAR (needs WinRAR) and TAR.GZ, with passwords (ZIP uses AES-256); extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO, CAB.
- Quick Convert: select files in File Explorer, press Ctrl+Alt+C or right-click > Quick Convert, and pick a format on a wheel.
- Updates install automatically in the background.

## Guides

- [Convert HEIC to JPG on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG on Windows 10 and 11 in batches, for free and without uploading them. S Converter also turns HEIC into PNG, WebP or PDF.
- [Convert WebP to JPG or PNG on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/webp-to-jpg/): Turn WebP images saved from websites into JPG or PNG on Windows, in batches, offline and free. Also converts AVIF, TIFF, BMP and GIF.
- [Convert JPG and other images to PDF on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/jpg-to-pdf/): Combine JPG, PNG and other images into one PDF, or make one PDF per image, on Windows. Free, offline, with pages in the order you choose.
- [Convert PDF pages to JPG images on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/pdf-to-jpg/): Save every page of a PDF as a JPG image on Windows 10 and 11. Free, offline, works on several PDFs at once.
- [Convert Word to PDF without Microsoft Office](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/word-to-pdf/): Convert DOCX and DOC files to PDF on Windows without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice. Keeps headings, lists, tables, pictures and links. Free and offline.
- [Convert PowerPoint to PDF without Office](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/powerpoint-to-pdf/): Turn PPTX presentations into PDF on Windows without PowerPoint. Each slide keeps its layout, pictures and colours. Free and offline.
- [Compress a PDF on Windows, offline](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compress-pdf/): Make PDFs smaller on Windows to email or upload them, while keeping text sharp. Free, works offline, handles several PDFs at once.
- [Merge PDF files on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one file on Windows, in the order you choose. Free, offline, no upload, no page limits.
- [Convert MKV to MP4 on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/mkv-to-mp4/): Convert MKV videos to MP4 on Windows using your NVIDIA, Intel or AMD graphics card for speed. Free, offline, batch conversion.
- [Extract MP3 audio from a video on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/video-to-mp3/): Pull the sound out of MP4, MKV, MOV and other videos as MP3 on Windows. Free, offline, with trimming and bitrate options.
- [Make a GIF from a video on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/video-to-gif/): Turn a video clip into an animated GIF on Windows. Trim it to the moment you want, then convert. Free and offline.
- [Resize and compress photos in bulk on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/resize-images/): Shrink and resize many photos at once on Windows for email, websites or storage. Set a maximum width and quality. Free and offline.
